description.value: This randomized controlled longitudinal study examined whether an 8-week mindfulness-based stress reduction program, compared with stress management education, changes fear-extinction retrieval, hippocampal activity and connectivity, and related structural measures.

spans.text: We tested these hypotheses in a randomized, controlled study using a well-established fear conditioning and extinction paradigm adapted for the MRI environment before and after an 8-week mindfulness-based or exercise-based stress management education program (MBSR or SME, respectively)( 26 – 28 ).
